reviewType: Independent agent code and bounded evidence review; not specialist approval

findings.detail: DTI and annuity tests check exact rounded expected outputs, but their forward residual checks currently reuse independently calculated raw candidates. This does not directly exercise the returned rounded output in the forward computation.
findings.requiredChange: DTI: forward(actual maximumLoanPrincipal) residual <= 0.005*abs(paymentFactor)+explicit floating epsilon. Annuity: abs(current*g+actual value*factor-target) <= 0.005*abs(factor)+explicit floating epsilon. Retain independent expected rounded checks.
findings.resolution: Re-inspected actual returned-principal payment and actual returned-contribution future value assertions. Both propagate half-cent quantization with explicit floating allowances (1e-9 payment, 1e-8 future value); independently reran focused tests after the change: 33/33 passed.

findings.detail: The graph workflows mount actual account actions with synthetic transport, validate raw output props and enabled export controls, then recover chart rendering. They do not click exports, reconcile generated files or prove real authenticated persistence.
